_comment: The anchor transaction that ACTUALLY EXECUTED on Monad mainnet, fetched from chain rather than constructed. Its calldata carries the SHA-256 and execution commitment of outputs/signed_orders.json; verify with verify_claims.py --chain, or decode the fields below by hand. Replaced 2026-08-26: the previous anchor (0xcf0cdd9f…a8e7, seq 2, orderHash 0xaee5fdf0…) bound an order executed on the RETIRED executors under the v1 attestation. This one binds the re-run against the V2-gated pair. The superseded artefacts are kept in outputs/archive/.

decoded.function: anchor(bytes32 orderHash, bytes32 execCommitment, uint64 seq)
